## Classes

### <a name="ai_bridge"></a>`ai_bridge`

Deploys an OpenAI-compatible bridge (LiteLLM) so Puppet Enterprise's
AI Agent can keep asking for `o4-mini` while Claude, a current OpenAI model,
Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server actually answers.

#### Examples

##### Claude behind the bridge (Hiera)

```puppet
ai_bridge::backend: anthropic
ai_bridge::upstream_model: claude-sonnet-4-5
ai_bridge::upstream_api_key: ENC[PKCS7,...]
ai_bridge::master_key: ENC[PKCS7,...]
ai_bridge::tls_cert: "%{lookup('profile::certs::ai_bridge_cert')}"
ai_bridge::tls_key: ENC[PKCS7,...]
```

##### Local Ollama model

```puppet
ai_bridge::backend: ollama
ai_bridge::upstream_model: 'qwen3:32b'
ai_bridge::upstream_base_url: http://ollama.souldo.lan:11434
```

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

`present` deploys and runs the bridge; `absent` stops it and removes all files.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--backend"></a>`backend`

Data type: `Ai_bridge::Backend`

Which provider answers. See `Ai_bridge::Backend`.

Default value: `'anthropic'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--upstream_model"></a>`upstream_model`

Data type: `String[1]`

Provider-side model name, e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `gpt-5-mini`, `qwen3:32b`.

Default value: `'claude-sonnet-4-5'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--upstream_api_key"></a>`upstream_api_key`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[String[1]]]`

Provider API key. Required for anthropic/openai; optional for openai_compatible;
ignored for ollama. Must be `Sensitive`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--upstream_base_url"></a>`upstream_base_url`

Data type: `Optional[Ai_bridge::Url]`

Base URL of the provider. Required for ollama (e.g. `http://host:11434`) and
openai_compatible (e.g. `http://host:8000/v1`).

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--ollama_think"></a>`ollama_think`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Optional Ollama thinking override for primary and alias Ollama models.
Unset preserves upstream defaults; false disables thinking.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--master_key"></a>`master_key`

Data type: `Sensitive[String[1]]`

The bearer token PE must present. This is what you paste into the PE console's
"API key" field. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Must be `Sensitive`.

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--exposed_model"></a>`exposed_model`

Data type: `String[1]`

The model name PE asks for. PE hard-codes `o4-mini`; change only if PE changes.

Default value: `'o4-mini'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--normalize_usage"></a>`normalize_usage`

Data type: `Boolean`

Opt-in PE usage-detail compatibility defaults; unreported detail fields become zero.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--manage_pe_aliases"></a>`manage_pe_aliases`

Data type: `Boolean`

Also expose the model names newer PE releases request (`gpt-5.4-mini`, `gpt-5.4`), each mapped
to the same upstream model as `exposed_model`. `extra_aliases` entries override these.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--tool_call_compat"></a>`tool_call_compat`

Data type: `Boolean`

Let models call tools when PE also sends a JSON-schema response format. Drops the
schema from a request until a tool result is present. Enable for PE 2026 with Ollama.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--personality_prompt"></a>`personality_prompt`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional response style text appended to chat system instructions. No permissions granted.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--extra_aliases"></a>`extra_aliases`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], String[1]]`

Additional `{ exposed_name => 'provider/model' }` entries, rendered verbatim
as LiteLLM model strings (e.g. `{'o3' => 'anthropic/claude-opus-4-1'}`). They
reuse the same api key / api_base as the primary backend.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--listen_port"></a>`listen_port`

Data type: `Ai_bridge::Port`

TCP port the bridge listens on. PE URL becomes `https://<host>:<port>/v1`.

Default value: `4000`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--manage_tls"></a>`manage_tls`

Data type: `Boolean`

Terminate TLS in the bridge. Strongly recommended; PE's JVM must trust the cert.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--tls_cert"></a>`tls_cert`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

PEM certificate (chain) contents. Required when `manage_tls` is true.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--tls_key"></a>`tls_key`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[String[1]]]`

PEM private key contents, `Sensitive`. Required when `manage_tls` is true.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--container_runtime"></a>`container_runtime`

Data type: `Enum['podman', 'docker']`

`podman` (default, runs rootless as the ai_bridge user) or `docker` (runs as root).

Default value: `'podman'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--image"></a>`image`

Data type: `String[1]`

LiteLLM container image. Pin a tag/digest in production.

Default value: `'ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:main-stable'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--install_dir"></a>`install_dir`

Data type: `Ai_bridge::Absolutepath`

Where config, env and TLS material live.

Default value: `'/opt/ai_bridge'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--user"></a>`user`

Data type: `String[1]`

System user that owns files and (with podman) runs the container.

Default value: `'ai_bridge'`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--drop_params"></a>`drop_params`

Data type: `Boolean`

Strip request params the backend doesn't support instead of failing. PE treats
o4-mini as a reasoning model and may send `reasoning_effort` etc. Keep true.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--request_timeout"></a>`request_timeout`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

Seconds LiteLLM waits for the provider.

Default value: `300`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--debug"></a>`debug`

Data type: `Boolean`

Sets `LITELLM_LOG=DEBUG`. Logs full prompts — troubleshooting only.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--manage_package"></a>`manage_package`

Data type: `Boolean`

Install the container runtime package.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ai_bridge--service_ensure"></a>`service_ensure`

Data type: `Enum['running', 'stopped']`

Service state when `ensure` is present.

Default value: `'running'`

## Data types

### <a name="Ai_bridge--Absolutepath"></a>`Ai_bridge::Absolutepath`

A Unix absolute path.

Alias of `Pattern[/\A\/[^\0]*\z/]`

### <a name="Ai_bridge--Backend"></a>`Ai_bridge::Backend`

- anthropic         Claude via the Anthropic API (needs upstream_api_key)
- openai            A current OpenAI model, pure rename (needs upstream_api_key)
- ollama            A local Ollama server (needs upstream_base_url)
- openai_compatible vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp, TGI, PAG… (needs upstream_base_url)

Alias of `Enum['anthropic', 'openai', 'ollama', 'openai_compatible']`

### <a name="Ai_bridge--Port"></a>`Ai_bridge::Port`

A TCP port.

Alias of `Integer[1, 65535]`

### <a name="Ai_bridge--Url"></a>`Ai_bridge::Url`

An http(s) URL.

Alias of `Pattern[/\Ahttps?:\/\/[^\s]+\z/]`

### <a name="docker_runtime"></a>`docker_runtime`

Check the existing Docker daemon, or explicitly install the distro Docker package on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 or Debian 12. Requires Python 3 and root for installation.

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `install_docker`

Data type: `Boolean`

Install docker.io and enable/start Docker only when the docker executable is absent. Existing installations are checked, never replaced or restarted.
